name: @hozon/native
description: Hozon adapter for the native hozon-sqlite engine

scripts.build: pnpm run build:clean && pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:types
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build:clean && pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:types:ci
scripts.test: pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:native: vitest run test/binding.test.ts test/compat.test.ts test/driver.test.ts test/conformance.test.ts test/starvation.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --exclude test/binding.test.ts --exclude test/compat.test.ts --exclude test/driver.test.ts --exclude test/conformance.test.ts --exclude test/starvation.test.ts
